name: office-gstr1-chat-v1
description: A CA office files a small client's monthly GSTR-1 from the sales invoices the client sends as PDFs on chat: each invoice is read (tax-inclusive round amounts, the taxable value backed out at 18%), the client's computation workbook shows the series and the earlier months, and the portal's tables are entered by hand: 4A (B2B, a buyer with a GSTIN), 5 (B2C Large: inter-state to an unregistered buyer over 1,00,000), 7 (B2C Others, one row per place of supply and rate), 12 (HSN, in its B2B and B2C tabs) and 13 (documents issued, cancelled ones counted), or the return filed nil; then the summary is generated and the return filed with EVC, whose OTP only the client has. Case 1 is the one a person demonstrates; the rest are new months: a registered buyer and a cancelled invoice, inter-state buyers with the portal opening on the current quarter, and a month with no bills. Cases 5 to 12 are the next months (January to July 2027, the workbook holding the months before), the same buyers and some new ones, about half of them plain and the rest with a cancelled invoice, a nil month, Kerala buyers again or an invoice sent twice on the chat, so a worker taught once can show its curve over fresh months. Graded on the portal's tables and filed return, exactly, and the ARN in the report. Fictional data; the ca-office mock.
